summary: Splash Beverage Group filed an 8-K to report a Development and Collaboration Agreement with Lupvindol Biosciences for FDA regulatory work on an animal drug derived from CannEpil. The agreement involves milestone payments totaling over $1 million and a 4% royalty, with an option for stock payment. This is a commercial development contract, not a special situation such as M&A, restructuring, or capital returns. The filing is routine and lacks elements of an event-driven special situation.
